title: SharonAI Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. (ticker: SHAZ) filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026, to correct a misstatement in its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (filed March 31, 2026) regarding NVIDIA Corporation's status as a strategic shareholder. The company clarifies that NVIDIA was never a strategic shareholder and holds no equity securities in SharonAI. The correction does not affect the company's financial statements.
key_points: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed Form 8-K on April 13, 2026
The filing corrects a statement in the Form 10-K (filed March 31, 2026) that incorrectly claimed NVIDIA was a strategic shareholder
NVIDIA Corporation was not and is not a strategic shareholder in SharonAI
NVIDIA does not hold any equity securities of the company as of the filing date
The correction does not impact the company's previously reported financial statements
Company is incorporated in Delaware, ticker SHAZ, listed on Nasdaq
